Sure, my policy number is seven eight two six five.
Thank you, Rose. Can you also confirm your date of birth for verification purposes?
Of course, my date of birth is zero one two one one nine eight nine.
Great, thank you for verifying your information, Rose. How can I assist you today?
I'd like to add a new vehicle to my policy.
I can assist you with that. Please provide the make and model of the vehicle.
Thank you for your time, Rose. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
